items.description: Repair of the storm-damaged shed roof section
items.rationale: Covered peril (storm), insured property (shed roof, ancillary structure per 4.2.5), repair to pre-loss standard (1.1, 7.1.5, 7.1.9). Indemnified at ordinary market price for the patch repair, not a full re-roof. Reference: similar roof repairs in earlier cases (e.g., wall/roof patching in cases 55, 51, 46).

items.description: Full repaint of the entire shed, including the undamaged walls
items.rationale: Work on undamaged parts is excluded (7.1.5, 7.1.6); only the affected area is indemnified, and this line covers the whole shed. Combined position (1.3, 7.1.10): as stated, not indemnified.
Protective treatments for future influences are excluded (7.1.8(a)), even if applied to affected parts.

items.description: Renewal of all shed trim, including undamaged trim
items.rationale: Work on undamaged parts is excluded (7.1.5, 7.1.10); combined position covers both damaged and undamaged trim, so not indemnified as stated.

items.description: Skilled carpentry labour for the roof repair
items.rationale: Labour for repair of affected part is covered (7.1.7(d)), at ordinary market rate for two skilled workers for one day. Reference: skilled worker/service technician hours in cases 56, 55, 51.

items.description: Contractor hand tools and reusable equipment
items.rationale: Ordinary equipment of the trade is excluded (1.3, 7.1.8(b)); deemed included in labour rate.
One vehicle/call-out charge per trade invoice is covered (7.1.7(f)), reference price per vehicle cost line (see price priors and cases 43, 44, 51, 55, 56).
Return visit/call-out charges are excluded (7.1.8(d)), not indemnified.
Catering/refreshment for contractor personnel is excluded (7.1.8(b)), not indemnified.

items.description: Cutting and removal of the storm-felled tree from the shed roof
items.rationale: Removal of storm-felled tree from insured property is covered as emergency/loss-mitigation and clearance (5.2.1, 5.2.3), at ordinary market rate for tree service. Reference: similar tree removal in storm claims.
Hire of heavy plant required for covered work is indemnified (7.1.7(e)), at ordinary market rate for machinery hire for tree removal.
One vehicle/call-out charge per trade invoice is covered (7.1.7(f)), reference price per vehicle cost line (see price priors and cases 43, 44, 51, 55, 56).

items.description: Disposal of shed roof timber and the broken glass pane (building debris)
items.rationale: Disposal of material arising from damaged insured property is covered (5.2.1), at ordinary market rate for building debris disposal. Reference: construction waste disposal in cases 56, 50, 46.

items.description: Disposal of felled-tree green waste and root ball (single mass under one cubic metre)
items.rationale: Disposal of storm-felled tree and root mass under 1 m³ is covered as material arising (5.2.1(b)), at ordinary market rate for green waste disposal.

items.description: Disposal and reinstatement of excavated soil and displaced paving around the shed
items.rationale: Grounds-reinstatement endorsement (GR-2026) brings ground reinstatement after insured tree impact into cover; disposal and reinstatement of soil/paving is indemnified at ordinary market rate.

items.description: Transport charge for the tree waste (already billed by the tree service)
items.rationale: Duplicate charge for same material transport is excluded (7.1.8(c)), not indemnified.
